definitions.explanation: A student in their third year of a given school level. In Japan, the third year is the final year of junior high and of high school, making this a significant designation for entrance exam preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}になった。
examples.english: My daughter has become a third-year student.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受験勉強|じゅけんべんきょう}→受験勉強：09977_jukenbenkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: Third-year high school students are busy with entrance exam preparation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When students become university juniors, many of them start their job search.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧ (three years) + {生|せい} (student). In Japan, both junior high and high school last three years, so {三年生|さんねんせい} marks the final year of those stages — an important year for entrance exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}: third-grader (elementary)
- ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year junior high student (final year)
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year high school student (final year)
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year university student
- {三年生|さんねんせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a third-year student

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧: first-year student
- ⟦{二年生|にねんせい}→二年生：27586_ninensei⟧: second-year student
- ⟦{四年生|よねんせい}→四年生：28268_yonensei⟧: fourth-year student (university senior)
- ⟦{受験生|じゅけんせい}→受験生：18622_jukensei⟧: examinee — often refers to third-year high school students preparing for university exams
